emma (PM): Draft PRD posted here: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-1234 — need concrete security acceptance criteria for launch: audit logs, KMS/HSM options, data retention, SOC2 gaps. Can @raj @sarah take a look?
raj (Security): On it. Quick Q: are we planning to require customer-managed HSM for GA or make it an enterprise opt-in? customers ask for both.
emma (PM): Default plan: platform-managed KMS for self-serve, enterprise can opt into HSM (BYOK or Redwood-managed HSM). Need acceptance tests for both modes.
liam (Eng): Implementation notes: audit events should be structured JSON, indexed for search. Ballpark: 50 bytes/event, worst-case 200M events/day for big tenants — storage and query cost implications. Retention must be configurable by org.
sarah (Compliance): For SOC2 controls: logs must be immutable, retention policy enforced, and key rotation policy documented. Default retention 1 year; regulated customers may require up to 7 years. Need chain-of-custody and proof of immutability in PRD.
nate (CS): +1. Two customers (health_fin and finOps) already asked: 7y retention + FIPS 140-2 HSM and exportable audit bundles for audits. They want push-button exports.
raj (Security): Draft acceptance criteria proposal: 
1) All API requests produce structured audit events (timestamp, request_id, user_id, org_id, action, result).
2) Events are signed/envelope-encrypted with platform KMS key by default.
3) HSM mode: private keys never leave HSM; provide attestation certificate and key IDs.
4) Retention tiers: 30 days / 1 year / 7 years configurable per org.
5) Deletion requests produce tamper-evident tombstone record (cannot silently delete without audit).
6) Access to logs is RBAC-gated and access itself is audited (who accessed which logs).
liam (Eng): Edge cases: KV cache may contain PII or prompt contents. Need opt-in flag per org: `log_full_input: true|false`. Default false. Also consider truncation/redaction pipeline for slow-path logs.
sarah (Compliance): Add a test case: attempt to access logs with escalated privileges and verify it is recorded and alerted. Also include key rotation proof (show old key ID + rotation event).
raj (Security): I'll draft an RFC that includes test steps and HSM attestation flow. Sample CLI snippets to include in RFC: `redwood kms rotate --key-id=org-123 --mode=hsm` and `redwood audit export --org=org-123 --from=2020-01-01 --to=2020-12-31 --format=ndjson`.
tom (Eng Manager): Perf constraints: log write path should be non-blocking for request latency. SLO: 95th write latency < 50ms under normal load; if async batching is used, ordering for a given request_id must be preserved. Also call out expected egress costs for long retention.
jira-bot: Created ticket RED-1234: "Security PRD: Audit logging, KMS & retention acceptance" — https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-1234
emma (PM): Nice. Next actions: raj + liam pair to add acceptance criteria block into PRD and open RFC PR by EOD Wed (2 weeks sprint target). Sarah will verify SOC2 mapping. Nate will collect contracts for the two customers asking 7y + HSM. I'll update roadmap and flag dependency in launch plan. :thumbsup:
raj (Security): I'll drop an initial RFC draft by tomorrow and add specific attestation sample payloads.
liam (Eng): I'll add perf and cost estimates to the PRD section.
sarah (Compliance): I'll annotate SOC2 control mappings and required evidence items.
nate (CS): I'll message the customers to capture exact export formats and any legal retention clauses.
emma (PM): Great — tagging this as "security-acceptance" in the PRD and blocking criterion for GA. Will share updated doc when merged. Thanks all :)
